featured_reviews.review_text: We started planning our wedding with this team more than a year in advance, and from day one they made the entire journey feel exciting, organised and completely stress-free. On top of that, the entire team is incredibly warm and friendly, so working with them never felt like a formal transaction but more like planning with friends who genuinely cared. Their ideas for each ceremony were fresh, creative and perfectly suited to the mood of the event, giving every function its own unique personality instead of a copy-paste template. What impressed us most was their attention to detail and flawless coordination on the actual wedding days; everything flowed so smoothly that we never once felt stressed or rushed. They handled vendors, logistics and last-minute changes with total calm and efficiency, shielding us from any chaos behind the scenes. They listened to our preferences, respected our budget and still managed to deliver something that felt grand, stylish and beautifully personalised. Because of them, we didn’t just “host” a wedding, we truly enjoyed every moment of it as guests at our own celebration. If you want planners who are organised, innovative, dependable and an absolute joy to work with, this is the team you want by your side

featured_reviews.name: Aditya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointing Experience – Proceed with Caution

Our wedding at Tropical Retreat turned into a deeply frustrating and disheartening experience, largely due to the event management and decoration team (commonly referred to as Bright Candle Events and Weddings (BELLA) on their panel).

From the very beginning, there was a clear pattern of poor execution combined with constant financial pressure. Despite the premium pricing, the quality of work delivered across multiple events was far below expectations.

One particularly upsetting incident occurred during the varmala ceremony — a moment that is supposed to be one of the most special parts of a wedding. As soon as the bride placed the varmala, it broke and fell apart instantly. This was not just embarrassing, but emotionally distressing for both families. Unfortunately, this was not an isolated issue — similar lapses happened across several functions.

What was even more disappointing was the complete lack of accountability. Not once did the team offer a genuine apology or take responsibility. Instead, the focus remained on extracting more money at every stage, often under pressure and at the last minute.

It honestly felt like a monopolistic setup, where the resort and their empanelled decorators operate in a way that leaves clients with no flexibility or alternatives. This creates a situation where you are compelled to accept substandard service while still being overcharged.

Important advice to future couples:
If you are considering this venue, only proceed if you are explicitly allowed to bring your own event planners and decorators. Otherwise, you risk facing the same combination of poor service and financial exploitation that we experienced.

**A wedding is a once-in-a-lifetime event — and unfortunately, this experience fell far short of what it should have been.**

I have all the photos and videos of all the mishaps, will be uploading everything soon.

featured_reviews.name: abhi santos
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you truly want your wedding day to be smooth and perfect, I strongly advise you to think twice before trusting Gautam Wedding Events.
My experience with them was extremely disappointing and caused unnecessary stress on one of the most important days of my life.

I had booked 50 “Pheta” pieces at ₹100 each for a 12 PM delivery, and this booking was done one month in advance. I even paid 50% advance to confirm the order.

But on the day of my wedding:
•	They completely forgot they had to come to my place.
•	Only after I reminded them did they say the exact Pheta I booked was not available.
•	They kept promising they would arrange the same colour, but from 10 AM to 1:30 PM, while my function had already started, they still failed to provide anything.

From my experience, it became very clear that:
•	They do not own their items — they borrow from others and pass it to customers.
•	They were highly unprofessional in handling something so important.
•	The people coordinating with us were immature and lacked basic manners or civic sense.

Because of their mismanagement and false assurances, my father was deeply hurt, as his only wish was that all the Baraatis wear Pheta — something we had booked well in advance.

Instead of fixing the issue, their only solution was “Take your advance back”, as if we could magically arrange 50 Phetas at the last moment.

I am writing this review so others do not go through the same embarrassment and stress.
Sometimes paying ₹100 extra to a reliable vendor is far better than risking your special day with careless and unprofessional service providers.

This was my genuine experience, and I hope it helps someone else make a better decision.

featured_reviews.name: Manish Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the best time working with genuinely the best event planners
“The Wedding Wale” A.K.A Reetu Jain, Jignesh Chouhan and Team.

They work like a family-they treat clients like a family and in the end we all become a big fat family.

They come on board, understand your vision for the wedding, guide you through and through to ensure the vision is achieved. I had my doubts initially but honestly they delivered.

They have an able experienced team to handle all departments of the wedding be it Hospitality, Logistics, F&B, Decor, Wedding designs and stationery etc.

They introduce you to good vendors be it for your Mehendi artists, make up, decor, photographers, celebrities, Sangeet choreography teams mainly all in sync with your budget. They have no qualms about you making any bookings directly and best part they co-ordinate with all the agencies perfectly on the big day so nothing is out of place.

They work very systematically. They set up the Timeline and Budget allocation chart at the onset. Like they tell you how to go about the wedding, make a timeline of things to do and allocate budgets based on your requirement starting from save the date, pre wedding photo shoot, invites, text messages to guests, artists bookings, venue recces, RSVP’s, food menus basically everything. This helps as you are working well ahead of time, in your stipulated budget and are relaxed.

The good thing about them is they are willing to go the extra mile until you are satisfied or see that smile on the client’s face.

Their USP is their Varmala and couple entries for each event. Irrespective of your budget- they plan in detail and truly make the Varmala and couple entries special and memorable for you. You could book them just for this.

We had endless late night long phone calls , many many meetings, million texts but they were always always available and consistent.

There are many wedding planners out there and tonnes of new ideas in the wedding industry every day. What I figured is on your big day you need a team that you trust and who work for you with a big smile and a warm heart.

I can vouch for the Wedding Wale team on that.

featured_reviews.name: Vibha Laljani
featured_reviews.review_text:
My parents found the Weddingwale to help plan my wedding ☺️ it was a lovely experience working with them.

As someone who had friends attending the wedding from outside Mumbai, one of my first concerns was how we'd arrange to receive/drop them from the airport. The Weddingwale made excellent arrangements for that! They also took care of different customizations for different guests (staying an extra day/arriving early etc). They continuously kept us posted about our guests' whereabouts related to travel.

Kavya was one of our primary day-to-day coordinators. In the final days before the wedding, working with her was like planning the wedding with my sister. We'd pore over wedding cakes on Instagram to finalize mine, and then talk about our favorite TV shows.

Reetu, Jignesh, Kavya, and the team were with us throughout from providing artist suggestions for floral jewelry to stepping in for the shadows when needed. They also provided us with a wonderful decorator.

I would definitely recommend them, because at no point did I feel that something would be dropped or left out.
